family.description: This is a family of transcriptional regulators. CaiF is involved in carnitine metabolism [[cite:PUB00077941]]. GrlA is encoded within the LEE type III secretion system in the enteropathogenic E. coli O157:H [[cite:PUB00076312]]. GrlR interacts with GrlA at its Helix-Turn-Helix (HTH) motif, preventing GrlA from binding to its target promoter DNA.
family.name: CaiF/GrlA transcriptional regulator
